_readme: Day-by-day study plan. days[] in order; each item: s=subject (P/C/M/X), ch=Bangla chapter name, en=English name, part, t=topics string, topicList=topics split into micro-tasks, k=kind, m=note, info=priority data (tier, rate, rank, full).

kinds.half: half day (two items share the day)
kinds.cls: full-syllabus class day (watch class + make formula sheet; practice next day)

phases.name: গতি তৈরি
phases.about: High-value, medium-difficulty chapters plus foundations; build the daily rhythm

phases.name: শীর্ষ পর্যায়
phases.about: Heaviest, most-asked chapters; includes catch-up day 1 (16 Nov)

phases.name: সমাপ্তি
phases.about: Lower-priority and rarely asked full-syllabus chapters; cut here first if behind; ends with catch-up day 2

dailyMethod: First 15 minutes: rewrite yesterday's key formulas from memory
Learn the listed topics in order (most-asked first); work textbook examples
End every chapter by solving all its real MIST questions without looking at solutions
Class days: watch the class and make a one-page formula sheet; practice next day
Half days: finish the first item before starting the second
Last 10 minutes: tick the day and write what is left
ifBehind: Never skip a chapter to stay on the calendar; finish it and use the next catch-up day (16 Nov, 14 Dec)

More than 2 days behind at 16 Nov: cut in this order only: যোগাশ্রয়ী প্রোগ্রাম to half day, বাস্তব সংখ্যা ও অসমতা to half day, then জ্যোতির্বিজ্ঞান and the fluid part of পদার্থের গাঠনিক ধর্ম to formulas only
Never cut a Tier 1 chapter, the MIST questions at the end of a chapter, or 15–18 December

endgame.what: Revision and model tests only: one full timed paper each morning, then fix every mistake; re-solve the Repeats list
